articles.title: US strikes Iran and Tehran fires back as hostilities flare again
articles.description: The U.S. military has hit targets in Iran, and Tehran has fired missiles and drones in response. Iranian officials say the latest U.S. attacks Tuesday hit a house hosting a wedding, killing two people. U.S. President Donald Trump says the strikes targeted Iranian radar systems. The latest strikes show hostilities are flaring once again in an intermittent war that has lasted more than six months. The U.S. strikes followed others on Sunday that abruptly ended a month without military action and threaten to fully reignite the conflict that's spiked global oil prices. Iranian state media reported that the U.S. had bombed civilian sites along Iran’s southern coast and hit a civilian airport.
